transactions.sale_price_citation: p28 transaction table: aggregate S$64.2m consideration for the three Australian properties (77 Logistics Place, 62 Sandstone Place, 92 Sandstone Place)
transactions.citation: p28 transaction table: aggregate S$64.2m consideration for the three Australian properties, no per-property split; Note 11 (p163): 'the Group completed the divestment of 77 Logistics Place, 62 Sandstone Place and 92 Sandstone Place ... recognising a gain amounting to $628,000 (A$710,000)'; Note 11 held-for-sale carrying amounts as at 31 Dec 2023: $24,359,000 / $14,345,000 / $23,728,000
transactions.notes: AGGREGATE DEAL — one sale, three properties, ONE consideration of S$64.2m and ONE gain of S$628,000; no per-property allocation disclosed anywhere in the AR. reference_value = summed carrying amount of the trio (24,359,000+14,345,000+23,728,000=62,432,000); gain_loss_pct = 628,000/62,432,000*100 = 1.01% (derived, book_value basis). This deal-level figure is repeated identically on all three property rows per spec. Per spec explicit warning: 92 Sandstone Place's own carrying value (23,728,000) EXCEEDS its own allocated valuation (19,300,000), so a per-property calculation would falsely show a loss on what was an aggregate-gain deal — per-property % deliberately NOT computed.
